## Description {#details}

<p>Compute iterated dominance frontiers using a linear time algorithm.</p>


<p>The algorithm used here is based on:</p>


<p>Sreedhar and Gao. A linear time algorithm for placing phi-nodes. In Proceedings of the 22nd ACM SIGPLAN-SIGACT Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages POPL '95. ACM, New York, NY, 62-73.</p>


<p>It has been modified to not explicitly use the DJ graph data structure and to directly compute pruned SSA using per-variable liveness information.</p>
